text:
Elaine: Customer ask - can we support sub-1h private deployment upgrades in-region with HSM rotations and minimal app downtime? Need options and acceptance criteria.
Michael: Two clear approaches: quick operator swap (45-60m) with planned IP hold and traffic drain, or per-tenant blue/green that trades total wall-time for near-zero app downtime per tenant.
Priya: HSM rotation is the big time sink for regulated customers. Auditors often demand manual sign-off + export of rotation artifacts.
Sam: Mitigation: pre-stage rotated keys in customer's KMS and only do final bind during the window. That reduces active binding work to minutes; still needs signed approval.
Rachel: NetOps: we'll only take on BGP/peering cutover if there's a tested runbook, rollback trigger, and paid support engagement. Otherwise customer owns the network switch.
Elaine: Product proposal: surface two checkboxes in console when scheduling upgrades: "Redwood-managed cutover" (premium, we do routing swap) and "Customer-managed cutover" (no uplift). Show preflight gating and SLA blurb.
Michael: Engineering needs to define automated rollback triggers (e.g., error-rate > 5% OR 99p latency spike) and an emergency revert API that SRE can call. Also require sequence-lock snapshot to allow rapid rollback of model state.
Priya: Legal must draft liability language for managed cutovers. For HSM customers we should require a staging dry-run and an exportable audit before permitting production windows.
Sam: OpsBot: preflight checks available -> /preflight <customer-id>. Suggested gates: IP reserved, DNS resolution, KMS keys preloaded, operator-health OK, model pin verified, KV-cache warm >= 90%.
Rachel: NetOps will produce a 1-page runbook and a verification script (AS-path proof, ACL checks) that we can link from console and include in field pack.
Elaine: Action items: Elaine draft preflight checklist & console copy; Michael spec rollback triggers & revert API; Rachel NetOps runbook + script; Priya own legal language + HSM acceptance criteria; Sam wire OpsBot gating and console block.
Michael: Pricing note: managed cutover should be a billable uplift and appear as an optional add-on on the order page.
Elaine: Let's reconvene Thu 10am PT after OpsBot preflight run. @Michael @Priya @Rachel @Sam please RSVP.
Michael: +1
Priya: +1
Sam: :thumbsup:
Rachel: On it
